note_wind.title: Elias's Note: Always Check the Wind
note_wind.text:
Always check the wind. It can lift you... or carry you far from your course.
— E.T.

note_sky_map.title: Elias's Note: The Sky Is a Map
note_sky_map.text:
Keep your eyes open, the sky is a map too.
— E.T.

note_each_island.title: Elias's Note: Each Island
note_each_island.text:
Each island has its own soul, its own weather, its own story.
— E.T.

note_three_decades.title: Elias's Note: Three Decades
note_three_decades.text:
Brindle Isle — a peaceful haven among the clouds. Its beauty is matched only by its mysteries. I have watched these skies for over three decades, and still, they hold secrets.
— E.T.

note_cloud_edge.title: Elias's Note: Cloud Edge
note_cloud_edge.text: The mist is thickest here. Be wary of sudden updrafts and shifting winds.

workshop_maps.title: Strange Maps
workshop_maps.text: Elias's maps don't agree with each other. The same island is drawn in three different places, each dated a few years apart. Notes in the margin: 'Not an error. It moved.'

workshop_sketches.title: Skyfarer Sketches
workshop_sketches.text: Pages of sketches: ancient fliers, brass instruments, Skyfarer markings. In the corner of one page, a small white creature with long feathered ears, drawn again and again from far away.

workshop_notes.title: Notes About Moving Islands
workshop_notes.text: Decades of weather logs. Wherever the wind behaves strangely, Elias marked it. One current is circled so many times the paper has worn through.

final_entry.title: Elias's Final Journal Entry
final_entry.text:
The maps are wrong. They always have been.
If you're reading this, look where the wind refuses to go.

piko_first.title: Piko's Notes: First Flight
piko_first.text:
(Kieran's note) He was sitting on the glider like he'd always belonged there. He won't leave. He chirps at the wind like it's talking back.

Piko — extremely helpful. Occasionally frustrating.

piko_wind.title: Piko's Notes: Hidden Currents
piko_wind.text: (Kieran's note) Piko found a current I couldn't see. His markings glowed when he did it. Where did he learn that?
